description: This file defines the internal class StreamDirectory, which manages streams associated with a specific silo in Orleans. It provides methods for retrieving, cleaning up, and disposing streams, and maintains a concurrent dictionary of streams identified by QualifiedStreamId.

classes.name: StreamDirectory
classes.description: An internal class that manages all streams associated with a specific silo, providing methods for stream retrieval, cleanup, and disposal.

methods.name: GetOrAddStream
methods.description: Retrieves an existing stream of type T by streamId or creates a new one using the provided streamCreator function. Throws an exception if the existing stream's type does not match T.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of streams, optionally for producers and consumers, unless suppressed by a test control flag. Waits for all cleanup tasks to complete.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all streams from the internal dictionary, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetStreamControl
methods.description: Retrieves the IStreamControl associated with a given streamId, if it exists.

methods.name: GetUsedStreamIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all stream IDs currently stored in the directory.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the StreamDirectory by performing cleanup of streams.
